style.styleTitle: Couples Silhouette And Arch Personalised Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A personalised Christmas bauble perfect for any newly married couple. The glass bauble surrounds the silhouette of a couple made from mirror acrylic standing in front of an engraved, frosted acrylic archway. The characters featured can be selected from the drop down to include same-sex couples and the frosted archway can be personalised with 3 areas of custom text. ‘Text line 1’ curves around the top of the archway ‘Text Field 2’ sits in the centre of the design and below this the year (i.e. 2023) can be engraved. No text is included as standard, the design will be engraved exactly as entered in the personalisation fields. The bauble measures approximately 10 x 10 cm.
